identity_rule: Hash exact Git/file bytes with lowercase SHA-256; bind source revision separately from later result revision; never embed an unknowable self commit SHA.
blocking: discovered required tests with active assertions
Windows/Web debug-on/off build outcomes or explicit environment classification
corroborative: human physical observation retained as PHYSICAL_PENDING until observed
physical_status: PHYSICAL_PENDING unless actual Windows/Web observation is performed
materialization_requirement: P31 package must be pushed as an immutable commit; P32 must push exact implementation/result/evidence revision before READY_FOR_CONTROL_REVIEW.
